conditions.minimum_rule: Assigned phase labels must be distinct and documented as reduced-model working aliases; failure blocks stronger conditions.
Each observed baseline edge must belong to the explicit allowed transition set; reverse and invalid edges are evaluated separately.
Target-state interpretation must depend on an admissible predecessor, not on target occurrence alone.
Reverse, scrambled, and deterministic non-baseline permutations must not be accepted as baseline cycles under the same detection rule.
Baseline recurrence must be present while negative controls preserve zero detected cycles under the same detector.
Bounded perturbation robustness may pass only with explicit perturbation outputs; otherwise it is not evaluable from current outputs.
Terminal state must return to the registered entry condition under assigned-phase and reduced-state proximity rules, without equating recurrence with full identity.
Final causal-structure class must follow reproducibly from C1-C7 and preserve unit, threshold, identity, and claim limitations.

final_class_rules.rule: C1 passes but C2 fails or is unresolved.
C7 fails because recurrence is equated with full identity or identity rule is missing.
C1-C5 pass, C6 passes or is not evaluable, C7 passes at reduced-model level, and C8 passes with limitations explicit.
C1-C5 and C7 pass but C8 requires human review.
C1-C3 pass but C4 or C5 fails.
Required evidence is missing before C1-C5 can be evaluated.
